timeline.title: Trial for Tupac Shakur's Murder Begins Nearly 30 Years Later
timeline.summary: The trial of Duane 'Keffe D' Davis, accused of orchestrating the 1996 murder of rapper Tupac Shakur, has commenced in Las Vegas. Jury selection began this week, nearly three decades after Shakur was fatally shot in a drive-by incident. Davis, who has pleaded not guilty, faces a potential life sentence without parole if convicted.
